input: Adding onboarding blogs and pitches for humans to onboard what their benefit is. Should be extensive. Very lacking currently. / What a human does in the repo and what benefits they get: develop ideas, personally monetize them freely and legally, little demand, just ideas input; what's developed stays MIT or similar and public but they can deploy or clone and run for profit; they get free development, about $8000 per month of AI coding agent compute for the repo.

doc_friction.issue: Several llms.txt files and ventures/README.md still name the retired monorepo-projects host; build.mjs rewrites it on publish, so the served files are fine, but writers copying links from source get the wrong host.
Says 'no valleys' while the README describes valleys for cross wings.
40-reply set figures (24 named, 17 right) differ from the README table (23 named, 16 right).
Did not check seo_title length, so three posts over the 70-char budget reached main and broke writing.mjs (every site build). Added the check.

The llms.txt date rule (6c847325) assumed 'no file dated' means 'no git history'; a partial (3,000-commit) history dates only some products, so every main deploy failed from the day it landed (109 problems on main). Fixed in build.mjs/lastmod.mjs: shallow builds stamp 'on or before <history start>'.

notes: Owner-directed run: a 16-post 'Start here' onboarding series (hub, a 'bring an idea' pitch: free AI development, MIT, run it for profit, honest limits; one post per flagship and per audience). New blog topic 'start' (tag start-here). $8,000/month compute is the owner's figure from the session message, not in any repo file. Checks run here: check_post_frontmatter.py exit 0; post_similarity.py --min 0.25 no start-here pair; check_md_links.py no dead links in 4948 files; node --test platform/pages/writing.test.mjs 21/21; test_check_post_frontmatter 17/17; writing.mjs build wrote 1173 pages with a 'Start here' chip of 16. Also fixed main's broken deploy: 4 overlong seo_titles (one merged mid-run) and the llms.txt date rule on shallow history. Local proof: depth-60 clone, node build.mjs + node check.mjs went from 1,311 problems to 'looks publishable: 1320 products, 5567 pages, no dead links'; full platform/pages suite 1334/1334.
